name: Grilled pork skewers
summary: Vietnam Tourism describes thick pieces of locally raised pork grilled on a skewer. Báo Kon Tum names thịt xiên at the cultural-night meal. Heo làng nướng, on the market list, is a separate name. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Mang Den. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism says the pigs are fed a natural diet and the meat is grilled in plump chunks on a skewer. A spice list was not printed.
Báo Kon Tum serves thịt xiên with cơm lam, gà nướng, bánh nếp, and rượu cần after the 6 January race opening.
A price is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Tourism does not name a street.
Báo Kon Tum places thịt xiên at the cultural night in Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”.
